# Markdown to PDF (md2pdf.marcopontili.com)

> Client-only Markdown to PDF converter. Runs in the browser, works offline, and never uploads your document for conversion.

Live app: https://md2pdf.marcopontili.com  
Source: https://github.com/marcop135/md2pdf

## When to use

Use this app when an agent or person needs to turn Markdown (GFM, Mermaid, optional HTML/`style` blocks) into a PDF via the browser print pipeline.

**Good fits**

- Export a Markdown document to PDF without a server
- Preview GFM and Mermaid before printing
- Drive the live UI from a coding agent with Playwriter

**Prefer something else for**

- Server-side or headless batch conversion APIs (this product has none)
- Hosted MCP tools (none; see `/auth.md`)
- Search indexing of private drafts (the app is intentionally `noindex`)

## How agents control the app

1. Open https://md2pdf.marcopontili.com/ (or a local Vite server on port 5173).
2. Wait until `window.md2pdf` is defined.
3. Call `window.md2pdf.setMarkdown(markdownString)`.
4. Call `await window.md2pdf.prepareExport()` so Mermaid and the preview settle.
5. Export with CDP `Page.printToPDF` (`printBackground: true`, `preferCSSPageSize: true`), or call `await window.md2pdf.exportPdf()` to open the print dialog.

Repo skill: `.claude/skills/md2pdf-export/SKILL.md` (Playwriter procedure).

## Machine-readable surfaces

- [For agents](https://md2pdf.marcopontili.com/for-agents.html): portal inventory
- [auth.md](https://md2pdf.marcopontili.com/auth.md): authentication (none)
- [openapi.json](https://md2pdf.marcopontili.com/openapi.json): public surface description
- [ARD catalog](https://md2pdf.marcopontili.com/.well-known/ard.json)
- [Agent skills index](https://md2pdf.marcopontili.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)

## Notes

- No accounts, API keys, OAuth, or hosted MCP.
- Conversion stays in the browser session.
- Crawlers remain disallowed in `robots.txt` by design; this file is for agents that already have the URL.
